summary: 국내에는 드물게 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 온몸이 흑갈색인 대형 맹금류이다. 산림과 농경지가 줄어들고 밀렵이 이어지면서 개체 수가 점점 줄고 있으며, 한국적색목록에서 멸종위기 범주로 평가되어 있다.

points.en: a few whitish spots on head and neck at close range

art.subject: Greater Spotted Eagle (Clanga clanga), adult as seen on Korean wetlands in winter (November–March): plumage almost uniformly dark blackish-brown, the head and body as dark as the wings; often a narrow whitish crescent on the uppertail coverts; flight feathers and tail blackish. Bill rather small for an eagle, dark grey, with a yellow cere and a gape line ending below the eye; dark brown eye; legs feathered with narrow, dark 'stovepipe' trousers; bare toes yellow.
art.pose: perched upright on a bare branch, side view
art.scene: Korean winter river floodplain: reedbeds, wet meadows and a lake edge with a few bare willow trees under a pale sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on a bare branch: large raptor build, uniformly blackish-brown, short rounded tail reaching about the folded wingtips, narrow dark feathered trousers, small dark bill with a yellow cere, yellow toes
juvenile, side view perched: blackish-brown with rows of bold white spots on the wing coverts and white tips to the secondaries and tertials, whitish uppertail-covert crescent, dark head
art.build: Medium-large, compact eagle, clearly larger and heavier than Eastern Buzzard but much smaller than Golden Eagle; rather short-necked and bull-headed with a relatively small bill. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short and rounded. In flight broad, parallel-edged wings with seven long fingers, held flat or with the hand slightly drooped when gliding, and a short rounded tail; looks dark and heavy.
avoid: Do not paint a golden-buff nape or a long tail — that is Golden Eagle.
Do not paint a pale nape patch or a long gape line extending behind the eye — that is Steppe Eagle (Aquila nipalensis).
Do not paint a pale buzzard pattern with dark carpal patches; the adult is uniformly dark.
Do not give the adult the juvenile's white-spotted wings.
